dedupe_keys.name: enhanced global oil spill incidents 1967 to 2023

description: The oil-spill incident research team publishes an enhanced global table of releases from 1967 through 2023. The Figshare version 3 deposit contains one Excel workbook derived from NOAA IncidentNews descriptions and updates. Its own description adds an estimated actual release amount, the text source for that value and an update label, supplementing the original maximum-potential information. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. Event locations and release quantities can help calibrate spill hazard scenarios or evaluate exposure around oil infrastructure and coastal services. No directly related catalogue record was identified. A caveat is that text-derived amounts may remain uncertain, especially when incident updates conflict or a final amount was never reported. The article reports 3,550 incidents, but workbook row count and geographic completeness were not checked here. Metadata and file name were read without downloading the incident table.
